description:
List resources

Lists the project's resources, oldest first, including retired ones unless `state` filters them out. Filter by `type`, by enabled `ability` and by comma-separated `state`. Lifecycle states are unallocated, active and retired; active means owned and non-retired, not provider-confirmed readiness. Every VoIP resource includes detail.activationState: activating or active, defaulting to active without owner-matched saved state. state=active includes numbers still activating. Requires the platforms:read permission bound to the project resource in the path.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/resources/list-resources

state.description: Comma-separated lifecycle states: unallocated, active or retired. active selects all owned, non-retired resources, including numbers whose detail.activationState is activating.

name: listResources

detail.description: Per-type public detail. Only voip_line includes activationState: activating or active. Every voip_line includes it; without an owner-matched saved record it defaults to active. This includes imported, legacy and unallocated numbers. This is not provider-confirmed readiness; elapsed time alone never changes saved activation. A retired number retains its saved activation state.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: Known values: ["unallocated","active","retired"]. Others may be added.
